note: the three secret trainers (CombatApprentice / SkillApprentice / WillApprentice) are GuildTraining entities whose test branches run in the DEPARTURE stage (their macros are CS_GUILD_DEPARTURE_*_TEST_*), so run this after guild_departure_stage

do: GuildTraining: local g = quest:GetThingWithScriptName('CombatApprentice'); if g ~= nil then quest:EntityTeleportToThing(quest:GetHero(), g, false) end
note: CombatApprentice 0x00D42F40: EARLY before the departure stage, DEPARTURE_HELLO once it is live
accept -> MELEE_START and the melee-only test; NO_BOW / NO_LIGHTNING are the disqualification lines when the hero uses the wrong thing

do: GuildTraining: local g = quest:GetThingWithScriptName('SkillApprentice'); if g ~= nil then quest:EntityTeleportToThing(quest:GetHero(), g, false) end
note: SkillApprentice 0x00D4C720: HELLO then the yes/no SKILL_QUESTION
the skill test arms two HUD counters (HUD_ICON_MULTI_ARROW + HUD_ICON_ARROW) and ends in one of the DEPARTURE_SKILL_TEST_ macros (END / A / APLUS / APLUS_PRIZE)

do: GuildTraining: local g = quest:GetThingWithScriptName('WillApprentice'); if g ~= nil then quest:EntityTeleportToThing(quest:GetHero(), g, false) end
note: WillApprentice 0x00D4EFE0: the HELLO question, then WILL_INTRO
the will test arms its own counter (HUD_ICON_ARROW -- retail's own icon, GOTCHAS) and grades into DEPARTURE_WILL_TEST_A / _B / _C / _APLUS

do: GuildTraining: local g = quest:GetThingWithScriptName('BirdKiller'); if g ~= nil then quest:EntityTeleportToThing(quest:GetHero(), g, false) end
note: BirdKiller 0x00D4DE30: GREET then the yes/no BIRD_KILLER_QUESTION -- run 21: this entity's region is not loaded at Guild arrival (GetThingWithScriptName returned an empty thing), it resolves in the departure window

yes -> the GULLS_INTRO cutscene macro arms the sparrows (KillBird entities); skip advances it -- run 21: this entity's region is not loaded at Guild arrival (GetThingWithScriptName returned an empty thing), it resolves in the departure window

do: GuildTraining: local g = quest:GetThingWithScriptName('BirdKiller'); if g ~= nil then quest:EntityTeleportToThing(quest:GetHero(), g, false) end
note: the payout is CurrentBirdsKilled * GUI_GoldPerBird and the counter resets; killing the gulls by hand is a separate check (the bow auto-aims, GOTCHAS) -- run 21: this entity's region is not loaded at Guild arrival (GetThingWithScriptName returned an empty thing), it resolves in the departure window

do: GuildTraining: local g = quest:GetThingWithScriptName('ApprenticeSpeedTest'); if g ~= nil then quest:EntityTeleportToThing(quest:GetHero(), g, false) end
note: ApprenticeSpeedTest 0x00D3FE60: the boast, then the yes/no race question -- run 21: this entity's region is not loaded at Guild arrival (GetThingWithScriptName returned an empty thing), it resolves in the departure window

yes -> FAST_APPRENTICE_RUN and the race timer; ReachedPlatform goes false at the start -- run 21: this entity's region is not loaded at Guild arrival (GetThingWithScriptName returned an empty thing), it resolves in the departure window

do: GuildTraining: local g = quest:GetThingWithScriptName('ApprenticeSpeedTest'); if g ~= nil then quest:EntityTeleportToThing(quest:GetHero(), g, false) end
note: the platform flag is what RaceMarker sets when the hero gets there; every outcome branch is acceptable here -- the check is that one of them runs and the payout path (GUI_RaceGold) does not error -- run 21: this entity's region is not loaded at Guild arrival (GetThingWithScriptName returned an empty thing), it resolves in the departure window
